_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the map. Coordinates are in each floor's map units (floors[].width x height, origin top-left). poly = room outline as [x, y] corners. Check with: python scripts/validate_data.py Optional name_en/name_zh and location_en/location_zh are used for English and Mandarin answers.
